name: cuda-reduction
seed: Implement a CUDA block reduction for float sum with arbitrary blockDim.x from 1 to 1024 and arbitrary n, including partial final blocks. Start with the correctness argument and give compilable device code.
rubric: Check block-wide barrier participation, shuffle caller masks and active sources, independent thread scheduling, non-power-of-two reductions, numerical error and exact arithmetic examples, measured occupancy and spills, grid-level synchronization, and explicit atomic ordering and scope. Ask unanticipated changes to constraints. Do not reject correct code simply because it differs from an expected implementation.
